description: This file defines a React functional component 'AddTagOption' used for rendering a UI element that allows users to add or remove tags to selected items within a web application. It manages state for menu visibility, handles interactions like linking/unlinking tags, and renders menu items with icons and labels. It references external controllers, utility functions, and components to facilitate its functionality.

classes.name: AddTagOption
classes.description: A React functional component that renders an interface for adding and removing tags to selected items, including managing menu state and handling tag link/unlink actions.

methods.name: toggleMenu
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the tag selection menu.

methods.name: isTagLinkedToSelectedItems
methods.description: Checks if a given tag is already linked to all selected items.

methods.name: linkTagToSelectedItems
methods.description: Links a given tag to all selected items.

methods.name: unlinkTagFromSelectedItems
methods.description: Removes a tag from all selected items.
